name: Mars Global Surveyor
about: Mars Global Surveyor (1996-062A, NASA/JPL), launched 1996 Nov  7. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.984 au and aphelion 1.489 au against GCAT's 0.981 and 1.494
